subtitle.en: Source: alesfer001/CrowdCell / contracts/campaign-lock/src/main.rs@acbb40e　·　0xd975…02a3 (data2, testnet only)　·　community contract, not independently audited

title.zh: Active campaign 原样延续（截止前认捐）

body.zh:
Cell{ capacity: C, type: {{campaign type}}, lock: { codeHash: CAMPAIGN_LOCK, args: {{deadline_block 8B}} } }
（同一 lock 的所有 group 输入都须满足）
body.en:
Cell{ capacity: C, type: {{campaign type}}, lock: { codeHash: CAMPAIGN_LOCK, args: {{deadline_block 8B}} } }
(every group input under this lock must qualify)

body.zh: 第一个带同一 campaign type 的输出：Cell{ lock: {{同一 lock}}, data(≥65B)[56] = {{0 Active}}, {{capacity ≥ C}} }
body.en: first output with the same campaign type: Cell{ lock: {{same lock}}, data(≥65B)[56] = {{0 Active}}, {{capacity ≥ C}} }

label.zh: lock args 字节布局（≥8B，多出的字节不读取）
label.en: lock args byte layout (≥8B; extra bytes not read)

cons.zh: 非延续路径要求 since ≥ 它

cond.en: reading lock, type, data or capacity fails

cond.zh: 全部 group 输入满足延续条件时：第一个同 type 输出的 capacity ≥ 输入（不满足则转入 B 的截止规则）
cond.en: when every group input qualifies: first same-type output has capacity ≥ input (otherwise the B deadline rules apply)

cond.zh: 延续条件：输入有 type；同 type 的第一个输出同 lock、data ≥ 65 字节且 status = 0 Active；任一不满足即转入 B
cond.en: carry-forward: input has a type; first same-type output has the same lock, data ≥ 65 bytes and status 0 Active; any failure falls to B

title.zh: 截止后花费（结算 / 销毁）

body.zh: Cell{ lock: {{deadline_block}} }, {{since（group 首个输入）= 绝对区块号 ≥ deadline_block}}
body.en: Cell{ lock: {{deadline_block}} }, {{since (first group input) = absolute block ≥ deadline_block}}

label.zh: outputs：任意（规则由 campaign 类型脚本约束）
label.en: outputs: any (rules from the campaign type script)

cond.zh: 第一个 group 输入的 since 必须绝对、标志合法、按区块号
cond.en: first group input since must be absolute, valid flags, block number

cond.zh: 区块号 ≥ deadline_block（since = 0 视为区块 0）
cond.en: block number ≥ deadline_block (since = 0 counts as block 0)

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs@acbb40e）：10 INVALID_ARGS（args < 8B，或 load_script 失败）· 11 LOAD_SINCE · 12 INVALID_SINCE · 13 SINCE_BELOW_DEADLINE · 14 LOAD_CELL · 15 CAPACITY_DECREASED
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs@acbb40e): 10 INVALID_ARGS (args < 8B, or load_script fails) · 11 LOAD_SINCE · 12 INVALID_SINCE · 13 SINCE_BELOW_DEADLINE · 14 LOAD_CELL · 15 CAPACITY_DECREASED

notes.zh: 延续路径要求 group 内每个输入都满足延续条件；只要有一个不满足，整组回落到 B 的截止规则（不报错，由 since 决定）。B 只读取 group 首个输入的 since
notes.en: The carry-forward path needs every group input to qualify; if one does not, the whole group falls back to the B deadline rules (no error of its own; since decides). B reads only the first group input's since

notes.zh: 不检查任何签名：谁都可以推进 campaign；内容合法性与 lock 不变（28）由 campaign 类型脚本保证
notes.en: No signature is checked: anyone can move the campaign; validity and lock preservation (28) come from the campaign type script
